name: reminders
description: Claude records unfinished work in Docs/todos.md; /todos shows the open list.

path.title: Reminders file
path.description: Where reminders are kept, relative to the project. Empty: docs/todos.md when the project has a docs folder, else Docs/todos.md.

showHeader.title: Reminders line above the prompt
showHeader.description: Show the open and blocking counts at the top right of the prompt. /todos --header on|off sets it too.
